presentation.label: ENV RESET AMP
presentation.summary: SOUND SETTINGS ENV RESET gains AMP and AMP+FILT: the amp envelope restarts from silence on every trig, so AMP ATK is heard on every hit.
presentation.overview: Env Reset Amp extends SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET from OFF and FILTER to OFF, AMP, FILTER and AMP+FILT. With AMP or AMP+FILT the amp envelope restarts from silence on every trig instead of continuing from its current level, so the AMP attack is heard on every hit. The setting belongs to the sound and is saved with it. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0015-env-reset-amp, with his shipping code unchanged.
highlights: ENV RESET steps OFF, AMP, FILTER, AMP+FILT.
With AMP set, AMP ATK is heard on every trig.
Saved with the sound, like stock's FILTER setting.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core.
usage: Use a build containing Env Reset Amp. Pick an analog BD sound and set AMP ATK to about 40 and DEC to 100 or more.
With ENV RESET at OFF or FILTER, hit the pad quickly several times: the attack is heard on the first hit only.
Open the SOUND menu (FUNC + MUTE) > SOUND SETTINGS and set ENV RESET to AMP: every hit now fades in at the ATK rate.

access.location: SOUND menu (FUNC + MUTE) > SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET.
steps: Press FUNC + MUTE to open the SOUND menu and choose SOUND SETTINGS.
Set ENV RESET to AMP or AMP+FILT.

controls.name: SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET
controls.doc: Steps OFF, AMP, FILTER, AMP+FILT. With AMP in the value, the amp envelope restarts from silence on every trig.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
A trig on a voice that is still sounding drops it to silence at once, which can click, most with ATK 0 and a long DEC.
On stock firmware a sound saved with AMP or AMP+FILT loads with the amp bit ignored.

load.display: Small: a few instructions on each trig's amp attack command
load.conditions: Static: the detour runs once per trig in the voice-command routine, looks up the track's ENV RESET byte and sends one command. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, env-reset-amp 1.0 passed its test (ENV RESET set to AMP, AMP ATK about 40 and a long DEC: the attack is heard on every quick hit) in R8T2 (2026-10-18), and its own test again with core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods ports in C3A4 (2026-10-20). On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-25) ENV RESET AMP restarted LT's amp envelope from silence on every quick hit (attack about 93 ms), where OFF carried it on, measured on LT's output. Alone on ERH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) AMP restarted LT's amp envelope from silence on every quick hit (attack about 86 ms) where OFF carried it on, measured on LT's output.
limitations: Tested builds: R8T2, .syx 94c8b8c4f3f537132b7ee689ad1221591186f14dc605a420cdefe3df804e3c39; C3A4, .syx 04d987ced36850eef5eb5cd1215d411edf621a5af94f980525ab561c9108f951. Firmware was not read back from the device.

SXH4 (the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-24/25, .syx e4d01a6aec250bd2af7743c9f8b0e9c560d805b52564932dddc41d872e1c5000) also carried a remote-control test layer that shares no site with core or the modules. ERH4 (alone with the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-25, .syx 98bb53a618952898d7657e5ead43727b5080d1a81c5fb1680c0ede85f7e02870) carried the same test layer.

tests.summary: Hardware: env-reset-amp 1.0's test passes on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74 (R8T2 with core-ar2 0.1, 2026-10-18; C3A4 with core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-20). Modwerk's source build gives a main OS byte-identical to elekloader's build of the rytm2_mods v1.2 release. In rytm-emu, ENV RESET steps through AMP and AMP+FILT, where stock steps between OFF and FILTER only.
